title: Summarize-Exemplify-Reflect: Data-driven Insight Distillation Empowers LLMs for Few-shot Tabular Classification

live_model.evidence: "For rule summarization in the preprocessing step, we use gpt-4-turbo" (Implementation); Table 7 "SumBoost (gpt-4-turbo) 12.3 14.5 15.8 ..." is a cost-in-USD table, not a task-performance table

prompt.location: Appendix B (baselines in B.2); "All base prompts are borrowed from TabLLM"

claim.metric: none: the only GPT-4-turbo-specific numbers are per-dataset USD costs (Table 7), not a task performance metric
